name: Apocryphal Inspiration
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) You and group members within 28 meters of you gain Major Fortitude, Major Intellect, and Major Endurance, increasing your Health Recovery, Magicka Recovery, and Stamina Recovery by 30%.

name: Archdruid Devyric
lines: (2 items) When you deal damage with a Heavy Attack, after 1.2 seconds deal 651 Shock damage to up to 6 enemies within a 7 by 5 meter line on your target, applying Major Vulnerability to them for 7 seconds, increasing the damage enemies take by 10%. This effect can occur once every 15 seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Archer's Mind
lines: (5 items) Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by 8%. Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by an additional 16% when you are Sneaking or Invisible.

name: Arkasis's Genius
lines: (5 items) Whenever you drink a potion while in combat, you and 3 group members gain 44 Ultimate. This effect can occur once every 30 seconds.

name: Arkay's Charity
lines: (5 items) When you cleanse a negative effect from yourself or an ally, restore 13 Ultimate to the target. This effect can occur once every 9 seconds per target.

name: Armor Master
lines: (5 items) While you have an Armor ability slotted, your Max Health is increased by 5%. When you use an Armor ability while in combat, your Physical and Spell Resistance is increased by 5940 for 10 seconds.

name: Armor of Truth
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) When you deal damage to an enemy who is Off Balance, your Weapon and Spell Damage are increased by 460 for 10 seconds.

name: Armor of the Code
lines: (1 item) Increase your Critical Chance against targets with a lower % of health than you by 2051.

name: Armor of the Seducer
lines: (5 items) Reduces the cost of your Magicka abilities by 10%.
